blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Despite the promise of Large Language Models (LLMs) in computational chemistry, rigorous combinatorial chemistry problems remain difficult because they require quantitatively constrained molecular modification, candidate validation, and systematic revision after failed attempts. Existing tool-augmented chemical agents demonstrate useful planning and tool use, but they rarely provide a unified loop for property-driven molecular optimization and workflow-level composition. To bridge this gap, we propose Tool-Grounded Multi-Agent Reasoning for Compositional Chemical Problem Solving (TMCS), a step-by-step multi-agent framework that formalizes chemical problem solving as an interpretable, tool-augmented workflow. At the task level, specialized agents leverage external tools, few-shot trajectory memory, and structured reflection to iteratively refine solutions. At the workflow level, TMCS chains generation, understanding, editing, description, and optimization into a closed-loop pipeline. Evaluations across multiple chemical tasks demonstrate that TMCS consistently enhances chemical reasoning across both open- and closed-source base models, achieving state-of-the-art performance.
blocks.zh: 尽管在计算化学中大语言模型(LLMs)有希望,但严格的组合化学问题仍然很困难,因为它们需要数量限制的分子改变,候选人验证,以及在尝试失败后进行系统的修改. 现有的工具强化化学剂表现出了有益的规划和工具使用,但它们很少为属性驱动的分子优化和工作流程级组成提供一个统一的循环. 为了弥补这一差距,我们提议采用工具组合的多剂方法解决组成化学品问题,这是一种逐步的多剂框架,将解决化学品问题正式化为一个可解释、工具强化的工作流程。 在任务层面,专业代理人利用外部工具,少镜头的轨迹记忆,以及结构化的反思来反复完善解决方案. 在工作流程层面,TMCS链生成,理解,编辑,描述,并优化为闭路管道. 跨多个化学任务的评价表明,TMCS在开放源码模型和封闭源码模型中不断加强化学推理,实现最先进的性能.

blocks.en: Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Large Language Models (LLMs) and specialized Chemical Language Models (CLMs) have recently emerged as a transformative force in accelerating drug discovery and materials science ( Bai et al. 2025 ; Ma et al. 2024 ; Shojaee et al. 2025 ; Hatakeyama-Sato et al. 2023 ; Xia et al. 2025 ; Han et al. 2025 ; Zhang et al. 2025 ; Xia et al. 2022 ; Lv et al. 2024 ; Zhang et al. 2024 ; Tan et al. 2025 ; Zhao et al. 2024 ; Jiang et al. 2025 ; Ross et al. 2022 ; Chithrananda et al. 2020 ; Ahmad et al. 2022 ) . However, rigorous chemical problem-solving—such as drug design—is inherently procedural rather than instantaneous. Such tasks are rarely resolved through a one-shot prediction; instead, they necessitate a logical sequence of operations, including structural understanding, targeted modification, and iterative refinement ( Ock et al. 2026 ) . This stepwise complexity underscores a critical yet overlooked requirement: true chemical intelligence must be assessed not solely by the final output, but by the system’s capacity for transparent, intermediate logical reasoning ( Hao et al. 2026 ) .
blocks.zh: 大型语言模型(LLMs)和专门的化学语言模型(CLMs)最近成为加速药物发现和材料科学的变革力量(Bai等人. 2025; Ma et al. 2024年;Shojaee等人,2025年;Hatakeyama-Sato等人。 2023; 霞等编. 2025; 韩等. 2025; 张等. 2025; 夏等编. 2022; Lv et al. 2024; 张等. 2024; Tan et al. 2025; 赵等. 2024; 蒋等. 2025; 罗斯等人著. 2022; Chithrananda 等人 2020; Ahmad 等人 2022). 然而,严格解决化学品问题——如药物设计——本质上是程序性的,而不是即时的。 这种任务很少通过一弹一弹的预测来解决;相反,它们需要逻辑的操作顺序,包括结构理解、定向修改和迭代改进(Ock等人,2026年)。 这种循序渐进的复杂性突出了一项关键但被忽视的要求:必须不仅根据最后产出,而且根据系统透明、中间逻辑推理的能力来评估真正的化学情报(Hao等人,2026年)。

blocks.en: Figure 1: Mean property improvement ( Δ \Delta ) across six molecular optimization objectives. The grouped bar charts compare the proposed TMCS framework against its corresponding generative baselines: Llama-3.3-70B-Instruct (left) and GPT-5.4 (right). TMCS consistently achieves superior Δ \Delta values across both physicochemical constraints and bioactivity targets. Higher positive values indicate successful property enhancements, whereas values near or below zero signify property degradations.

blocks.en: Existing paradigms face bottlenecks that hinder this procedural reasoning ( Wang et al. 2025 ; Bai et al. 2025 ; Li et al. 2026 ; Solovev et al. 2025 ; Lee et al. 2026 ; Liu et al. 2024 ) . First, at the individual task level, most methods treat chemical problems as direct, end-to-end predictions. Large language models (LLMs) and diffusion-based approaches map an input directly to an output relying on parameterized, black-box knowledge. This lacks reasoning transparency: structural changes are not visible step-by-step, making it difficult to interpret why a candidate succeeds or fails under fine-grained chemical constraints. Second, at the execution level, standard models exhibit what we term execution rigidity. Even when basic external tools are introduced, they rarely revise their strategy after a failed attempt, lack explicit reflection, and cannot reuse prior successful trajectories. Finally, at the workflow level, existing models often operate in knowledge isolation, executing tasks like generation, understanding, and optimization as disjointed processes rather than a continuous, cohesive pipeline.
blocks.zh: 现有的范式面临着阻碍这一程序推理的瓶颈(Wang等人,2025年;Bai等人). 2025; 李等人著. 2026; Solovev et al. 2025; Lee等人著. 2026; 刘等 2024). 首先,在个别任务层面,大多数方法将化学问题视为直接的,端到端的预测. 大型语言模型(LLMs)和基于传播的方法将一个输入直接映射到一个依赖于参数化的黑框知识的输出. 这缺乏推理透明度:结构变化不明显是一步步的,因此难以解释候选人在精细的化学限制下成功或失败的原因. 第二,在执行层面,标准模型显示了我们所说的执行僵硬性。 即使引入了基本的外部工具,它们也很少在尝试失败后修改策略,缺乏明确的反射,无法重新使用之前成功的轨迹. 最后,在工作流程一级,现有的模型往往在知识隔离状态下运作,执行诸如生成、理解和优化等任务,作为脱节的进程,而不是一个连续、连贯的管道。

blocks.en: The core difficulty is particularly acute for molecular optimization. A useful drug-design assistant must not only generate a syntactically valid molecule, but also determine whether a local edit actually improves logP, QED, solubility, or target-specific bioactivity while preserving a meaningful scaffold. Pure LLM prompting can express chemical intuition, yet it cannot reliably observe the quantitative consequence of each edit. Conversely, standalone tools can score or validate candidates but do not decide how to revise a failed design. This gap motivates a framework in which the LLM proposes chemically plausible actions, external tools provide objective feedback, and a bounded reflection loop revises the strategy only when the current trajectory is invalid or insufficiently improved.
blocks.zh: 核心难度对于分子优化尤其尖锐. 一个有用的药物设计助手不仅必须生成一个在战术上有效的分子,而且还必须确定一个本地编辑是否真正改善了logP,QED,溶解性,或者目标特定的生物活性,同时保留一个有意义的脚手架. 纯LLM提示可以表达化学直觉,然而它无法可靠地观察每次编辑的定量后果. 相反,独立工具可以对候选人进行评分或验证,但不决定如何修改一个失败的设计。 这一空白促使形成了一个框架,即LLM提出化学上可行的行动,外部工具提供客观的反馈,一个有限度的反射循环只有在当前轨迹无效或改进不足时才修改战略.

blocks.en:
To address these limitations, we propose TMCS, an interpretable, stepwise multi-agent framework for chemical problem solving. Built on the principle that chemical reasoning requires structured execution rather than simple black-box scaling, TMCS shifts the paradigm from one-shot generation to a closed-loop, tool-grounded refinement process. To achieve this, we introduce a dual-level optimization strategy.
First, we introduce the Task-Level Iterative Refinement: rather than stopping after a single prediction, TMCS decomposes individual tasks into executable stages. Specialized agents handle understanding, editing, and description, while external tools provide deterministic property validation. A reflection module monitors intermediate outputs and triggers strategy revision upon failure, guided by a few-shot trajectory memory that preserves reusable patterns from successful cases. As shown in Figure 1 , our framework achieves significant improvements in property optimization for both open-source and closed-source models.
blocks.zh:
为了解决这些局限性,我们提议采用可解释的、渐进的多种剂框架,解决化学品问题。 TMCS基于化学推理需要结构化执行而不是简单的黑盒缩放的原则,将范式从一发一代转向闭锁式,基于工具的完善过程. 为了实现这一目标,我们引入了双层优化战略。
首先,我们提出任务层次的累变:在单一预测之后,TMCS不是停止,而是将单个任务分解为可执行阶段。 专业代理处理理解,编辑,和描述,而外部工具则提供决定性的财产验证. 一个反射模块监测中间输出,并在失败时触发战略修改,其指导方向是几发弹道记忆,从成功的案例中保留可重复使用的模式. 如图1所示,我们的框架在开源模型和闭源模型的属性优化方面都取得了显著改善。

blocks.en: Second, we introduce the Workflow-Level Composition: moving beyond isolated execution, TMCS chains these diverse, optimized tasks into a unified pipeline. By passing context sequentially–from molecular generation, to structural understanding, and finally to targeted optimization–the framework ensures that insights gained in early stages directly inform downstream reasoning. This dual-level design improves interpretability, as every edit is linked to a specific structural rationale and validation result.
blocks.zh: 第二,我们提出工作流程-层次构成:超越孤立的执行,TMCS链条这些多样化的,优化的任务变成统一的管道. 该框架通过从分子生成到结构理解、最后到目标优化的顺序上传,确保了早期获得的洞察力直接为下游推理提供信息。 这种双层设计提高了可解释性,因为每个编辑都与特定的结构原理和验证结果相联系.

blocks.en: Extensive evaluations show that TMCS substantially improves both open-source and closed-source base models, achieving state-of-the-art performance. Component, initialization, robustness, and cost analyses further indicate that the gains arise from verifiable tool-grounded feedback and bounded reflection rather than from unconstrained extra computation alone.
blocks.zh: 广泛的评价表明,TMCS大大改进了开源和闭源基模型,实现了最先进的性能. 构成部分、初始化、稳健性和成本分析进一步表明,收益来自可核查的工具反馈和有限度的反射,而不是仅来自不受限制的额外计算。

blocks.en: Our main contributions are summarized as follows: • We propose TMCS , a stepwise multi-agent reasoning framework that transitions chemical problem solving from opaque, one-shot predictions to a transparent, closed-loop refinement process. • We design a dual-level execution architecture : at the task level, it enhances structural understanding and optimization through tool-use, few-shot reasoning trajectories, and reflection; at the workflow level, it composes these tasks into a unified, sequential pipeline. • We conduct extensive experiments showing that TMCS broadly enhances both open and closed-source LLMs. The framework yields substantial performance enhancements, achieving state-of-the-art results in chemical reasoning tasks and highlighting the superiority of structured execution.
blocks.zh: • 我们的主要贡献概述如下: 我们提出TMCS,这是一个渐进式的多剂推理框架,将化学问题的解决从不透明、一弹即发的预测过渡到透明、封闭的改进过程。 我们设计了双层执行架构:在任务层面,它通过工具使用,几发推理轨迹,以及反射,增强结构理解和优化;在工作流程层面,它将这些任务编成一个统一,顺序排列的管道. 我们进行了广泛的实验,表明TMCS广泛加强了开放源代码和封闭源代码的有限责任公司。 该框架产生实质性的性能增强,在化学推理任务中实现最先进的成果,并突出结构化执行的优越性.

blocks.en: We propose TMCS , a stepwise multi-agent reasoning framework that transitions chemical problem solving from opaque, one-shot predictions to a transparent, closed-loop refinement process.
blocks.zh: 我们提出TMCS, 一个渐进式的多剂推理框架, 将化学问题的解决从不透明、一弹一弹的预测 转变为透明、封闭的改进过程。

blocks.en: We design a dual-level execution architecture : at the task level, it enhances structural understanding and optimization through tool-use, few-shot reasoning trajectories, and reflection; at the workflow level, it composes these tasks into a unified, sequential pipeline.

blocks.en: We conduct extensive experiments showing that TMCS broadly enhances both open and closed-source LLMs. The framework yields substantial performance enhancements, achieving state-of-the-art results in chemical reasoning tasks and highlighting the superiority of structured execution.
blocks.zh: 我们进行了广泛的实验,表明TMCS广泛加强了开放源代码和封闭源代码的有限责任公司。 该框架产生实质性的性能增强,在化学推理任务中实现最先进的成果,并突出结构化执行的优越性.

blocks.en: Related work
blocks.zh: 相关工作

blocks.en: Chemical Reasoning Models and Evaluation
blocks.zh: 化学理由模型和评价

blocks.en: Prior work shows that many traditional evaluations emphasize factual recall and short-answer prediction, making it hard to distinguish knowledge retrieval from genuine chemical reasoning ( Hao et al. 2026 ; Guo et al. 2025 ) . To address this gap, ChemCoTBench formulates molecular add/delete/substitute operations as reasoning primitives, promoting a modular evaluation paradigm that better matches chemist workflows ( Hao et al. 2026 ) . Meanwhile, chemistry foundation models such as ChemLLM, ChemDFM, and LlasMol have improved performance on molecular and reaction tasks ( Zhang et al. 2024 ; Zhao et al. 2025 ; Yu et al. 2024 ) , but they still face limitations in cross-task robustness, reasoning consistency, and interpretability ( Wang et al. 2025 ) . More recent methods, such as Chem-R, introduce protocol-guided distillation, process-level supervision, and reinforcement-style optimization to improve the reliability of long-horizon chemical reasoning ( Wang et al. 2025 ; Bai et al. 2025 )
blocks.zh: 以前的工作表明,许多传统评价都强调事实回顾和短答预测,因此很难区分知识检索与真正的化学推理(Hao等人)。 2026; 郭等2025 (中文(简体) ). 为了弥补这一差距,ChemCoTBench将分子加/去除/替代操作作为推理原始,促进一个模块化评价范式,更好地配合化学工作流程(Hao等人,2026年). 同时,ChemLLM,ChemDFM,LlasMol等化学基础模型在分子和反应任务上提高了性能(张等人. 2024; 赵等. 2025; Yu et al. 2024),但他们在跨任务稳健性,推理一致性,可解释性方面仍然面临限制(Wang et al. 2025). 更近期的方法,如Chem-R,引入了协议制导蒸馏,过程层监督,强化式优化,以提高长视化学推理的可靠性(Wang等人,2025年;Bai等人,2025年).

blocks.en: Multi-Agent Systems for Drug Discovery
blocks.zh: 多剂药物发现系统

blocks.en: Another major direction is tool-augmented multi-agent systems for drug discovery. Frameworks such as ChemCrow, ChemAgent, CACTUS, and DrugAgent combine LLM planning with chemistry tools, establishing increasingly mature workflows for molecular understanding, reaction analysis, and candidate generation ( Bran et al. 2023 ; Tang et al. 2025 ; Liu et al. 2024 ) . MADD further extends this paradigm toward end-to-end hit identification through task decomposition and agent orchestration ( Solovev et al. 2025 ) . However, closed-loop molecular optimization remains underexplored. It requires quantitatively constrained structural edits, multi-property balancing, candidate validation, and systematic revision after failed modifications. Existing systems provide limited support and suffer from scarce optimization trajectories, tool-chain error accumulation, and cost and privacy constraints ( Solovev et al. 2025 ; Bran et al. 2023 ) . ChemCRAFT partially addresses these issues by delegating deterministic computation to external tools while retaining high-level decisions within the model ( Li et al. 2026 ) . This gap motivates TMCS, which integrates structured reasoning, tool-grounded validation, and multi-agent execution for reliable molecular optimization.
blocks.zh: 另一个主要方向是用于药物发现的工具强化多剂系统。 ChemCrow,ChemAgent,CACTUS,DrugAgent等框架将LLM规划与化学工具相结合,为分子理解,反应分析以及候选生成建立了日益成熟的工作流程(Bran等人. 2023; 唐等编. 2025; 刘等. 2024 (中文(简体) ). MADD通过任务分解和剂管弦法将这一范式进一步扩展到端到端的命中识别(Solovev等人,2025年)。 然而,闭环分子优化仍然未得到充分探索. 它需要数量限制的结构编辑,多财产平衡,候选人验证,以及在修改失败后进行系统修改. 现有系统提供有限的支持,并受到稀缺的优化轨迹、工具链误差积累以及成本和隐私限制的影响(Solovev等人,2025年;Bran等人,2023年)。 ChemCRAFT将确定性计算权下放给外部工具,同时保留模型内的高级别决定权(Li等人,2026年),以部分解决这些问题。 这一缺口激发了TMCS的动力,它融合了结构化推理,基于工具的验证,以及可靠分子优化的多剂执行.

blocks.en: Compared with these systems, TMCS focuses specifically on property-driven molecular optimization and its composition with upstream generation and understanding tasks. As summarized in Table 1 , TMCS integrates tool use, memory, and reflection into an optimization-oriented protocol in which candidate molecules are generated, externally validated, scored by property oracles, and revised through bounded feedback.
blocks.zh: 与这些系统相比,TMCS特别侧重于属性驱动的分子优化及其与上游生成和理解任务的组成. 如表1所概述,TMCS将工具的使用,内存,反射整合到一个面向优化的协议中,其中候选分子生成,外部验证,被属性甲骨文评分,并通过有界限的反馈修改.

blocks.en: Method
blocks.zh: 方法

blocks.en: Overview of the TMCS Framework
blocks.zh: 三. 监测、监测和监视框架概述

blocks.en: We formulate chemical problem solving as a structured dual-level reasoning process that maps an optional combined query x = ( x text , x mol ) x=(x_{\text{text}},x_{\text{mol}}) to an optimized output y y . Rather than relying on a single black-box prediction, our framework decomposes complex tasks through a holistic architecture. As illustrated in Figure 2 , the TMCS framework is supported by three foundational pillars: the Task Routing Agent, the Trajectory Memory Bank, and the Chemical Tool Service.
blocks.zh: 我们将化学问题解决作为一个结构化的双层推理过程,将可选的组合查询x=(x文本,x mol)x=(xQQText{text}},xXQText{mol}})映射为优化输出y. 我们的框架不是依靠单一的黑箱预测,而是通过整体架构来分解复杂的任务. 如图2所示,TMCS框架由三个基本支柱支持:任务排行代理、Traphicary Memory Bank和化学工具服务。

blocks.en: Given an input x x , the framework operates across two granularities. At the Workflow-Level , macro-tasks are sequentially chained (e.g., generation → \rightarrow analysis → \rightarrow optimization). At the Task-Level , each specialized agent assigned by the Task Router executes a self-evolving loop. Formally, the end-to-end execution can be denoted as the composition of K K specialized agents: y final = ( ∏ k = 1 K A k ) ​ ( x , ℳ , 𝒯 ) y_{\text{final}}=\left(\prod_{k=1}^{K}A_{k}\right)(x;\mathcal{M},\mathcal{T}) (1) where ℳ \mathcal{M} represents the dynamic trajectory memory and 𝒯 \mathcal{T} represents the integrated tool suite. This compositional design guarantees both macroscopic task coherence across diverse reasoning stages and microscopic structural precision at the atomic level.
blocks.zh: 在输入 xx 的情况下,这个框架在两个颗粒内运作。 在工作流程级别(Workflow-level)中,宏观任务按顺序排列(如生成 ~\右旋分析 ~\右旋优化). 在任务级别(Task-level)上,由任务路由器指派的每个专门代理都会执行一个自演循环. 形式上,端对端执行可以表示为 K K 专业代理的构成: y final = (∏ k = 1 K A k) (x, M, T ) y _{\ text{ finally}}=\ 左 (\prod_{k = 1}^{ K} A_{k}\ 右 (x);\ mathcal{M},\ mathcal{T} (1)其中 M\ mathcal{M} 代表动态轨迹内存, T\ mathcal{T} 代表集成工具套件. 这种结构设计既保证了不同推理阶段的宏观任务一致性,又保证了原子一级的微观结构精度。

blocks.en: Chemical Tool Service
blocks.zh: 化学工具服务

blocks.en: To ground LLM reasoning in executable chemistry, TMCS instantiates a hybrid tool stack 𝒯 \mathcal{T} that normalizes all tool invocations into JSON-compatible program calls ( Li et al. 2026 ; Wang et al. 2025 ) . The stack supports structural validation, deterministic property calculation, and constrained molecular editing. Candidate molecules must be chemically parseable, while editing operations are additionally verified through SMARTS-count changes to ensure that the requested functional group is added, removed, or replaced exactly as specified. Physicochemical descriptors, molecular similarities, structural patterns, and pharmacological properties are computed using deterministic backends or aligned predictive models rather than inferred directly by the LLM.
blocks.zh: 为在可执行化学中进行LLM推理,TMCS即时将一个混合工具堆栈T\ mathcal{T}将所有工具引用规范化为JSON兼容程序调用(Li等人,2026年;Wang等人,2025年). 堆栈支持结构验证,确定属性计算,以及受限制的分子编辑. 候选分子必须具有化学解析性,而编辑操作则通过SMARTS计数变化进行额外验证,以确保所请求的功能组被添加,移除,或完全按照指定替换. 物理化学描述符、分子相似性、结构模式和药理性质是使用确定性后端或对齐的预测模型计算的,而不是由LLM直接推断的。

blocks.en: For molecular design and captioning, TMCS employs a specialized model derived from Chem-R as a replaceable generation tool. Generated structures and guarded LLM fallback outputs are subjected to the same validity and edit-consistency checks before being accepted into the workflow. This design combines deterministic chemical execution with flexible generation while maintaining a strict validation boundary. A complete description of the tools, interfaces, and functional roles is provided in supplementary materials.
blocks.zh: 在分子设计和标题方面,TMCS采用了一种源于Chem-R的专门模型作为替代生成工具. 生成的架构和被保护的LLM倒置输出在被接受进入工作流程之前,同样的有效性和编辑一致性检查. 这种设计将定型化学执行与弹性生成相结合,同时保持严格的验证边界. 补充材料中提供了工具、接口和功能作用的完整说明。

blocks.en: Trajectory Memory Construction and Retrieval
blocks.zh: 轨迹内存构建和检索

blocks.en: To mitigate zero-shot instability during complex chemical reasoning, we introduce an offline-constructed Few-Shot Trajectory Memory Bank, denoted by ℳ \mathcal{M} , which supplies executable priors during inference. As shown in supplementary materials, we provide additional specifications regarding this section.
blocks.zh: 为了减轻复杂化学推理过程中的零射线不稳定性,我们引入了一个离线构造的"少Shot轨迹记忆库",由M\mathcal{M}表示,该存储库在推论中提供可执行前科. 如补充材料所示,我们对本节作了补充说明。

blocks.en: As shown in Figure 3 , we construct our instruction dataset following ( Li et al. 2026 ) through a three-step process. First, we collect high-fidelity molecular pairs, property annotations, and functional descriptions from databases like ChEBI and PubChem, standardizing them into a uniform SMILES-centric format based on task types. Second, we integrate these data instances with strategy templates that explicitly decompose chemical transformations into logical, tool-executable cognitive steps (i.e., structural analysis, optimization strategy, and validation). Finally, we employ large language models and external tools to infer initial reasoning trajectories.
blocks.zh: 如图3所示,我们通过一个三步进程构建我们的指示数据集(Li等人,2026年)。 首先,我们从ChEBI和PubChem等数据库中收集高真分子对,属性说明,以及功能描述,将它们标准化为基于任务类型的以SMILES为中心的统一格式. 第二,我们将这些数据实例与战略模板整合,这些模板将化学转化明确分解为逻辑的,工具可执行的认知步骤(即结构分析,优化策略,以及验证). 最后,我们使用大型语言模型和外部工具来推断初步推理轨迹.

blocks.en: We construct a task-bounded memory bank that encapsulates structured, deterministically executable exemplars (e.g., tool-call records) across molecular understanding, editing, and optimization tasks. To ensure rigorous structural alignment, we employ a deterministic, symbolic indexing mechanism based on exact key matching directed by task types. By directly matching exemplars to the specific task category, we guarantee that the retrieved trajectories are strictly compatible with the active query and immediately applicable to the current chemical problem. Each specific task is associated with its corresponding few-shot demonstrations. Furthermore, to rigorously prevent train-test contamination, the memory bank is constructed entirely offline, remains frozen during evaluation, and enforces strict structural disjointness from the test sets through canonical de-duplication and topological distance thresholding.
blocks.zh: 我们构建了一个任务捆绑的内存库,囊括结构化,决定性的可执行实例(如工具调用记录),跨越分子理解,编辑和优化任务. 为了确保严格的结构一致,我们采用了一种基于任务类型所指示的精确密钥匹配的确定性、象征性的指数化机制。 通过直接将实例与具体任务类别匹配,我们保证检索的轨迹与主动查询严格兼容,并立即适用于当前的化学问题. 每项具体任务都与其相应的几弹演示有关。 此外,为了严格防止火车试验污染,内存库是完全离线建造的,在评价期间仍然冻结,并通过峡谷脱钩和地形距离阈值,执行与试验装置严格的结构脱节。

blocks.en: Task-Level: Tool-Grounded Agent Loop
blocks.zh: 任务级别: 工具组合代理循环

blocks.en: Upon receiving a specific task assignment from the Router Agent, the system initiates the core Agent Loop . As shown in Figure 3 , taking the property optimization task as a representative paradigm, the internal loop dynamically orchestrates a sequence of actions based on the current context.
blocks.zh: 系统在接到路由器代理的具体任务任务后,启动核心代理循环. 如图3所示,将属性优化任务作为代表性范式,内部循环动态地根据当前背景安排一系列动作.

blocks.en: The chemical agent loop proceeds through four integrated phases: (1) Feature Calculation , where the agent invokes 𝒯 calc \mathcal{T}_{\text{calc}} to extract physicochemical features (e.g., functional group counts and molecular weight) from the current molecule y ( t − 1 ) y^{(t-1)} ; (2) Strategy Formulation , where guided by the extracted features, target constraints, and retrieved memory ℳ \mathcal{M} , the agent articulates a targeted structural modification strategy z ( t ) z^{(t)} ; (3) Generation & Editing , where the agent utilizes 𝒯 edit \mathcal{T}_{\text{edit}} or 𝒯 gen \mathcal{T}_{\text{gen}} to actualize the proposed strategy, yielding a candidate molecule y ( t ) y^{(t)} along with its generation rationale; and (4) Analysis & Validation , where the candidate is rigorously evaluated via 𝒯 valid \mathcal{T}_{\text{valid}} and 𝒯 calc \mathcal{T}_{\text{calc}} to return an objective feedback vector 𝐫 ( t ) \mathbf{r}^{(t)} .
blocks.zh: 化学剂循环通过四个综合阶段进行: (1) 特性计算,即代理人援引T calc\ mathcal{T}_{\text{calc}从当前分子y(t−1)y^{(t−1)}中提取物理化学特征(如功能组数和分子重量); (2) 战略制定,在所提取的特性、目标限制和检索的内存M\ mathcal{M}的指导下,代理人阐明一种有针对性的结构修改战略z(t) z(t)}; (3) 生成和编辑,其中代理使用 T 编辑\ mathcal{ T}_{\text{ edit} 或 T gen\ mathcal{ T}_{\text{ gen} 实现拟议策略,生成一个候选分子 y (t) y^{(t)} 及其生成理由;和 (4) 分析和验证,其中通过 T 有效的\ mathcal{ T}_{\text{ valid} 和 T calc\ mathcal{ T}_{\text{ calc} 严格评价候选人,以返回客观反馈矢量 r (t)\ mathb{r}^{(t)} 。

blocks.en: Upon receiving the feedback vector, the agent performs a reflection operation to analyze the current solution’s efficacy. In our implementation, molecular optimization uses at most three refinement rounds and generates three candidates per round. The best valid candidate is selected according to property improvement and scaffold similarity; if no candidate improves the objective, the next prompt receives explicit feedback describing the best failed attempt and whether more conservative or more aggressive edits are needed. The reflection module classifies errors into format, structural, counting, logic, hallucination, or unknown categories, then appends a targeted correction prompt rather than an open-ended instruction to “think again.” This self-evaluation drives further iterative refinement, ultimately culminating in the final task solution and a comprehensive analytical summary report.
blocks.zh: 接收反馈矢量后,剂会进行反射操作,分析当前溶液的功效. 在我们的实施中,分子优化最多使用三轮精炼,每轮产生三名候选人. 最佳有效候选人根据地产改进和脚手架相似性来选择;如果没有候选人改善目标,下个提示会得到明确的反馈,描述最佳失败的尝试,以及是否需要更保守或更积极的编辑. 反射模块将错误分为格式,结构,计数,逻辑,幻觉,或未知的类别,然后附加一个定向的校正提示而不是一个无限制的指令来“再次思考”. 这种自我评价推动进一步的迭代完善,最终导致最终任务解决方案和一份全面分析总结报告。

blocks.en: Workflow-Level: Compositional Chemical Pipeline
blocks.zh: 工作流程-水平:组成化学管道

blocks.en: For multifaceted, real-world chemical challenges (e.g., designing a targeted drug from a raw textual description), a single autonomous loop is insufficient due to context window dilution and error accumulation. At the workflow level, TMCS chains diverse, specialized agents into a macroscopic pipeline.
blocks.zh: 对于多方面的,现实世界的化学挑战(例如,从原始文字描述中设计一种定向药物),由于上下文窗口稀释和错误积累,一个单一的自主循环是不够的. 在工作流程一级,TMCS链条多种多样,专业化的代理商进入一个宏观的管道。

blocks.en: As shown in Figure 2 , the workflow initiates with a Molecule Generation Agent translating textual descriptions (e.g., “an indole alkaloid derivative”) into initial structural scaffolds. The finalized summary of this agent is seamlessly handed over as the initial context to a Molecule Analysis Agent , which isolates modifiable substituents. Finally, the Property Optimization Agent receives this focused analysis to perform the targeted refinement loop discussed above. This compositional architecture ensures that the cognitive load is compartmentalized, preventing the cascading of hallucinations while preserving high-fidelity reasoning across complex chemical workflows.
blocks.zh: 如图2所示,工作流程以分子生成剂启动,将文字描述(例如“indole alkaloid衍生物”)转换为初始结构脚手架。 该剂的最终摘要作为初始上下文无缝地移交给分子分析剂,该分析剂隔离了可修改的子结构。 最后,财产优化代理公司收到这种重点分析,以进行上文讨论的有针对性的完善循环。 这种构成结构确保了认知负载被分割,防止了幻觉的串联,同时保留了跨越复杂化学工作流程的高真实性推理.

blocks.en: Figure 4: Example of QED attribute optimization.
blocks.zh: 图4:QED属性优化实例.

blocks.en: Experiments
blocks.zh: 实验

blocks.en: Experimental Setup
blocks.zh: 实验设置

blocks.en: Benchmark. To comprehensively validate our framework, we conducted evaluations across a broad spectrum of tasks. At the task level, we evaluated drug molecule design and molecular description from ChemLLMBench ( Guo et al. 2023 ) , alongside molecular understanding, molecular editing, and property optimization tasks from ChemCoTBench ( Hao et al. 2026 ) . At the workflow level, we utilized the molecular design task ( Guo et al. 2023 ) as an initialization point to sequentially drive downstream optimization tasks and evaluate the optimization performance across six distinct molecular properties.
blocks.zh: 基准。 为了全面验证我们的框架,我们进行了范围广泛的评估。 在任务层面,我们评价了ChemLLMBench(Guo等人,2023年)的药物分子设计和分子描述,同时评价了ChemCoTBench(Hao等人,2026年)的分子理解,分子编辑,以及财产优化任务. 在工作流程层面,我们利用分子设计任务(Guo等人,2023年)作为初始化点,依次驱动下游优化任务,并评价6个不同分子属性的优化性能.

blocks.en: Evaluation Metrics. For rigorous and fair benchmarking, we follow standard protocols from prior work ( Guo et al. 2023 ; Hao et al. 2026 ) . Molecular design is evaluated by exact SMILES match, while molecule captioning uses BLEU-4. Molecular understanding evaluates functional-group and ring counting with Mean Absolute Error (MAE), Murcko scaffold extraction with Tanimoto similarity, complex-ring detection with accuracy, and SMILES equivalence as a binary classification task using accuracy. Molecular editing is measured by Pass@1, indicating whether the edited structure strictly follows the instruction, whereas molecular optimization is assessed by average property improvement. Direct LLM baselines receive task-specific optimization prompts and the same property oracles as TMCS; complementary ablations and cost analyses further distinguish architectural gains from those due to additional inference budget. The LLM parameters are set to ‘temperature = 0.3‘ and max tokens are 512, with up to eight retries upon failure.
blocks.zh: 评价计量。 为了制定严格和公平的基准,我们遵循先前工作的标准协议(Guo et al. 2023; 郝等 2026 (中文(简体) ). 分子设计通过精确的SMILES匹配来评价,而分子标题则使用BLEU-4. 分子理解用平均绝对误差(MAE)来评价功能组和环数,Murcko脚手架提取与田本相似,复杂环检测精度,SMILES等效使用精度作为二进制分类任务. 分子编辑用Pass@1测量,说明编辑的结构是否严格遵循指令,而分子优化则通过平均属性改进来评估. 直接的LLM基线得到特定任务优化提示和与TMCS相同的属性甲骨文;互补的拼接和成本分析进一步区分建筑收益和由于额外推论预算而产生的收益. LLM参数设定为‘温度=0.3',最大令牌为512,失败时最多进行8次重试.

blocks.en: Baselines. To establish a rigorous and comprehensive comparison, we categorize our baselines into three distinct paradigms. For direct reasoning, we adopt the direct inference baselines established in ChemCoTBench to evaluate standard prompting capabilities ( Grattafiori et al. 2024 ; Hurst et al. 2024 ; Guo et al. 2025 ; Comanici et al. 2025 ; Singh et al. 2025 ) . For domain-specific systems, we select Chem-R, ether0 ( Narayanan et al. 2026 ) , and ChemCRAFT as our primary comparators. Finally, to validate the generalizability of our proposed framework at both the task and workflow levels, we deploy TMCS on top of leading foundational models, utilizing both open-source (specifically Llama-3.3-70B-Instruct ) and closed-source (specifically GPT-5.4 ) LLMs as our base models.
blocks.zh: 基线。 为了进行严格和全面的比较,我们把我们的基线分为三个不同的范式。 为了直接推理,我们采用在ChemCoTBench中确立的直接推论基线,以评估标准催化能力(Grattafiori等人)。 2024; Hurst等人著. 2024; 郭等编. 2025年;Comanici等人,2025年;Singh等人,2025年). 对于特定域的系统,我们选择Chem-R、eer0(Narayanan等人,2026年)和ChemCRAFT作为我们的主要参照国。 最后,为了验证我们拟议框架在任务和工作流程层面的可通用性,我们在主要基础模型之上部署技术监控系统,同时使用开放源码(具体来说是Llama-3.3-70B-Instruct)和封闭源码(具体来说是GPT-5.4)LLMs作为我们的基础模型。

blocks.en: Task-Level Benchmark Results. Table 2 shows that TMCS achieves strong gains across molecular understanding, editing, generation, and description, outperforming strong LLM baselines particularly on tasks requiring multi-step reasoning, precise structural manipulation, or description generation. These results demonstrate that the same stepwise reasoning architecture generalizes beyond a single optimization objective. They also justify a dedicated molecular optimization module: because text-to-molecule generation may produce plausible scaffolds but cannot ensure property improvement under structural constraints, TMCS uses generation only for initialization and applies tool-grounded optimization to obtain quantitatively improved candidates.
blocks.zh: 任务级基准成果。 表2显示,TMCS在分子理解、编辑、生成和描述方面都取得了巨大收益,特别是在需要多步骤推理、精确结构操纵或描述生成的任务方面,表现优于强有力的LLM基线。 这些结果表明,同样的阶梯推理架构超越了单一优化目标。 它们也证明专门的分子优化模块是合理的:由于文本到分子生成可能会产生合理的脚手架,但无法在结构限制下确保财产改善,TMCS只使用生成用于初始化,并应用基于工具的优化以获得数量改进的候选者.

blocks.en: Table 3 summarizes the task-level benchmark performance on multiple optimization objectives. TMCS consistently improves property scores across LogP, solubility, QED, DRD2, JNK3, and GSK3- β \beta . Compared with both open and closed baselines, our method exhibits stronger optimization ability and more stable success rates.
blocks.zh: 表3汇总了多项优化目标的任务一级基准业绩。 TMCS在LogP,溶解性,QED,DRD2,JNK3和GSK3-β\β\β之间不断改进属性分数. 与开放和封闭的基线相比,我们的方法显示出更强大的优化能力和更稳定的成功率。

blocks.en: Table 4: Workflow-level optimization-stage results: comparison between the task-specific Pure LLM Baseline and TMCS across six molecular objectives. We report Δ \Delta (mean net property change over all 100 cases, including positive and negative changes) and SR (success rate, %). 70B represents Llama-3.3-70B-Instruct.
blocks.zh: 表4 工作流级优化阶段结果:任务特异性纯LLM基线与TMCS在6个分子目标的比较. 我们报告\\Delta(在所有100个案例中,平均净财产变化,包括正负变化)和SR(成功率,%)。 70B代表Llama-3.3-70B-指令.

blocks.en: While the Llama-3.3-70B-Instruct model exhibits limited reasoning capabilities in direct inference tasks, the integration of the TMCS framework leads to substantial performance gains. Similarly, although powerful proprietary models like GPT-5.4 demonstrate baseline effectiveness in zero-shot settings, their performance is further amplified by TMCS. These results underscore that the TMCS framework provides a robust, universal mechanism for unlocking high-tier chemical reasoning, regardless of the underlying model’s initial architecture.
blocks.zh: 虽然Llama-3.3-70B-指令模型在直接推论任务中表现出有限的推理能力,但TMCS框架的整合却导致了实质性的绩效收益. 同样,虽然GPT-5.4等强大的专有模型在零射的环境下证明了基线有效性,但其性能被TMCS进一步放大. 这些结果突出表明,不论基本模型的初始结构如何,TMCS框架为解锁高层次化学推理提供了强有力的普遍机制。

blocks.en: Workflow-Level Pipeline Performance. To test whether the individual task gains can be composed into a stronger end-to-end system, we start from drug molecule generation and then perform downstream optimization. We compare the tool-enhanced pipeline against a single-turn, task-specific LLM baseline.
blocks.zh: 工作流- 水平管道性能. 为了测试单个任务增益是否能够组成一个更强大的端到端系统,我们从药物分子生成开始,然后进行下游优化. 我们把工具强化管道与单回合、任务特定LLM基线进行比较。

blocks.en: Table 4 presents the core results of this workflow-level optimization stage, whose initialization setting differs from the standalone task-level benchmark in Table 3 . We compare the Tool-enhanced TMCS framework against a Pure LLM Baseline using task-specific prompts but no external feedback during generation. The results demonstrate a significant performance gap, particularly in properties like DRD2 and JNK3, where the lack of quantitative feedback causes the pure LLM to struggle ( ∼ \sim 15%–42% success). In contrast, TMCS leverages tool-grounded feedback to achieve a substantial performance boost, reaching success rates as high as 98%.
blocks.zh: 表4列出了这一工作流程一级优化阶段的核心结果,其初始化设定不同于表3中的独立任务级别基准。 我们利用特定任务的提示,将工具强化TMCS框架与纯LLM基线进行比较,但生成过程中没有外部反馈。 结果显示了显著的性能差距,特别是在DRD2和JNK3等属性中,由于缺少定量反馈,导致纯LLM挣扎(\\sim 15~%~42%成功). 与此相对照,TMCS利用基于工具的反馈实现实质性的性能提升,成功率高达98%.

blocks.en: The table reports two complementary workflow-level measures over all 100 molecules. SR is the fraction with a positive change, whereas Δ \Delta is the net mean change after summing both positive and negative changes. TMCS improves SR for all six objectives on both backbones, and its all-sample Δ \Delta is higher on all six objectives for 70B and on five of six objectives for GPT-5.4. This combination shows that TMCS is more stable across molecules rather than relying on a small number of large gains.
blocks.zh: 该表报告了针对所有100个分子的两种补充工作流程水平措施。 SR是带有正变的分数,而\\Delta是总结正变和负变后的净平均变化. TMCS改进了两个支柱上所有6个目标的SR,其全样本QQ\Delta在70B的所有6个目标以及GPT-5.4的6个目标中的5个目标上都更高. 这种组合表明,TMCS在分子间较为稳定,而不是依赖少量的大型增益.

blocks.en: For GPT-5.4 , the stability advantage is especially clear on the black-box objectives: TMCS raises SR from 42.0% to 80.0% on DRD2, from 30.0% to 96.0% on JNK3, and from 35.0% to 90.0% on GSK3- β \beta ; their net mean changes increase from 0.002 to 0.148, 0.004 to 0.054, and 0.003 to 0.124, respectively. Solubility is the only Δ \Delta exception: the baseline reaches 1.305 versus TMCS’s 1.062, but TMCS still improves SR from 80.0% to 92.0%. Thus, the baseline’s larger solubility magnitude does not overturn the broader evidence that tool-grounded feedback yields more reliable molecule-level improvements.
blocks.zh: 对于GPT-5.4,稳定性优势在黑匣子目标上尤为明显:TMCS将SR在DRD2上从42.0%提高到80.0%,在JNK3上从30.0%提高到96.0%,在GSK3-β\β上从35.0%提高到90.0%;其净平均变化分别从0.002提高到0.148,0.004提高到0.054,0.003提高到0.124. 溶解度是唯一的 \\ Delta 例外: 基线为 1. 305, 而 TMCS 的 1. 062, 但 TMCS 仍能改善 SR, 从 80.0 % 到 92.0% 。 因此,基线的更大溶解度并不能推翻以工具为基础的反馈产生更可靠的分子级改进的更广泛证据。

blocks.en: Ablation Study
blocks.zh: 阅读研究

blocks.en: Component Ablation Table 6 shows the contribution of each component on two representative optimization objectives, LogP and DRD2. The full model achieves the best performance on both metrics. Removing memory or tools consistently degrades performance, confirming that the gains cannot be attributed only to extra LLM calls.
blocks.zh: 表6显示每个组成部分对两个代表性优化目标(LogP和DRD2)的贡献。 完整的模型在两个度量衡上都取得了最佳的性能. 删除内存或工具会不断降低性能,确认收益不能仅仅归因于额外的LLM呼叫.

blocks.en: The results reveal three important trends. First, removing few-shot memory reduces both improvement and success rate, indicating that reusable trajectory patterns are helpful for selecting better edits. Second, removing tools causes a larger drop in success rate, suggesting that deterministic validation is important for producing reliable candidates.
blocks.zh: 结果揭示了三大趋势。 首先,去除几发内存既降低了改进率,也降低了成功率,表明可重复使用的轨迹模式有助于选择更好的编辑. 第二,移除工具导致成功率下降较大,这表明确定性验证对于产生可靠的候选人很重要。

blocks.en: Regarding the ablation of reflection frequency, as shown in Table 6 , removing reflection weakens the system’s ability to escape local plateaus, which is especially visible in the optimization tasks that require iterative refinement. One round already improves over the direct baseline, while five rounds only marginally improve solubility Δ \Delta from 0.92 to 0.93 compared with the three-round TMCS setting. We therefore use three rounds as the default because it captures nearly all of the performance gain while avoiding the additional latency and token cost of longer reflection. For tasks such as molecular understanding, a single reflection step is sufficient to achieve optimal performance, so we restrict the reflection mechanism to a single iteration for these tasks.
blocks.zh: 关于反射频率的缩小,如表6所示,去除反射会削弱系统逃离当地高原的能力,这一点在需要反复改进的优化任务中尤其明显。 一回合比直接基线已经有所改善,而五回合只略微提高了溶解度 QQ\德尔塔从0.92到0.93,与三回合的TMCS设置相比. 因此,我们使用三轮作为默认,因为它捕捉了几乎所有的性能收益,同时避免了延长反射的额外延迟和象征性成本。 对于分子理解等任务,一个单一的反射步骤就足以实现最佳的性能,因此我们将反射机制限制在这些任务的单个迭代上.

blocks.en: Additionally, we provide a detailed statistical significance and robustness analysis in supplementary materials, followed by a computational cost and efficiency analysis of our framework in supplementary materials.
blocks.zh: 此外,我们还在补充材料中提供了详细的统计意义和稳健性分析,随后对补充材料中的框架进行了计算成本和效率分析。

blocks.en: Impact of Initialization Source. To further understand the robustness of TMCS, we investigate the impact of the initialization source on optimization success. As shown in Table 7 , we split the cases into those starting from generated molecules ( Generated-Start ) and those falling back to ground-truth molecules ( GT-Start ).
blocks.zh: 初始化的影响。 为了进一步理解TMCS的稳健性,我们调查初始化源对优化成功的影响. 如表7所示,我们把病例分为从生成的分子(生成-开始)开始的病例和回到地面真实分子(GT-开始)的病例。

blocks.en: A key finding is that pure LLM optimization is highly sensitive to the starting source: performance varies substantially between generated scaffolds and ground-truth scaffolds across DRD2, GSK3- β \beta , and JNK3. TMCS remains consistently strong in both settings. When the initial molecule is produced by a general molecular generator, TMCS can still further optimize it; when the system starts from a ground-truth scaffold, TMCS also improves it. Thus, Chem-R-style initialization is useful but not the sole source of the final gain; the tool-grounded optimization loop supplies the decisive navigation signal.
blocks.zh: 一个关键发现是纯LLM优化对起始源高度敏感:跨DRD2,GSK3-β\β和JNK3的生成脚手架和地面真实脚手架之间的性能差异很大. 在这两种情况下,监测、监测和监视措施始终很有力。 当初始分子由一般分子发生器产生时,TMCS仍然可以进一步优化它;当系统从地面-真实的脚手架开始时,TMCS也会改进它. 因此, Chem-R风格的初始化是有用的,但不是最终收益的唯一来源;基于工具的优化循环提供决定性的导航信号.

blocks.en: Efficiency Trade-off. The multi-agent framework intentionally spends more inference than single-turn prompting because it performs candidate generation, tool scoring, and reflection. However, this overhead is controlled rather than open-ended: molecular optimization is capped at three rounds with three candidates per round, deterministic tasks are routed directly to tools, and short tasks use at most one reflection. Supplementary materials quantifies this trade-off. Direct inference is cheaper, but it lacks the feedback channel needed for long-step optimization; TMCS pays additional tokens only for modules that expose intermediate chemical evidence. The reflection-round ablation further shows that extending the loop beyond the default budget produces negligible gains, supporting the chosen quality-efficiency balance.
blocks.zh: 效率权衡。 多代理框架有意花在推论上,而不是一转即决,因为它进行候选生成、工具评分和反思。 然而,这种间接费用是控制而不是开放的:分子优化的上限为三轮,每轮有3名候选人,确定性任务直接被引导到工具上,短任务最多使用一次反射. 补充材料将这种权衡加以量化。 直接推论比较便宜,但缺乏长步优化所需的反馈通道;TMCS只为暴露中间化学证据的模块支付额外的代币. 反省圆通进一步表明,将环线延伸至默认预算之外会产生可忽略不计的收益,支持选定的质量效率平衡。

blocks.en: Case Study. To provide an implementation-level qualitative analysis, Figure 4 illustrates a three-round QED optimization trajectory driven by the proposed pipeline. As depicted, the system integrates the task prompt, deterministic tool feedback, and few-shot structural rationales to initialize the generation cycle.
blocks.zh: 个案研究。 为了提供执行层面的质量分析,图4显示了由拟议管道驱动的三轮QED优化轨迹。 如所描述的,系统整合了任务即时,决定性的工具反馈,以及几发的结构原理来初始化生成周期.

blocks.en: Starting from the initial compound ( s 0 s_{0} , QED = 0.3354 \mathrm{QED}=0.3354 ), Round 1 executes a localized structural edit—replacing the PAINS-flagged hydroxamic acid liability with an acetyl group. When the trajectory plateaus in Round 2, the ReflectionAgent actively intervenes. By analyzing the updated tool profiles, it explicitly diagnoses that although the QED improved, the naphthalene ring system remained overly bulky.
blocks.zh: 从初始化合物(s0 s_{0},QED = 0.3354\ mathrm{QED}=0.3354)开始,第1轮执行一个局部结构编辑——用乙酰基组取代PAINS-flign的氢氧化酸责任. 当第2回合的轨迹高原出现时,反射剂积极介入. 通过分析更新的工具简介,它明确诊断出,虽然QED改进了,但邻苯环系统仍然过于庞大。

blocks.en: Conditioned on these tool-grounded diagnostics, the agent dynamically refreshes its strategy for Round 3. It shifts from localized editing to a deeper scaffold simplification (e.g., replacing the fused bicyclic naphthalene motif with a simpler para-substituted variant). This case concretely demonstrates the efficacy of the multi-round reflective logic: it detects stagnation, performs precise credit assignment via explicit diagnostics, and successfully escapes local optima that single-pass generative models typically fail to overcome.
blocks.zh: 基于这些基于工具的诊断,该剂动态地更新了第三轮的战略。 它从本地化编辑转向更深层次的脚手架简化(例如,用一个更简单的准替代变体来取代被熔化的双环纳苯摩提夫). 这个案例具体地证明了多轮反射逻辑的功效:它检测到停滞,通过明确的诊断来进行精确的信用分配,成功逃脱了局部选择,即单传基因模型通常无法克服.

blocks.en: Conclusion
blocks.zh: 结论

blocks.en: TMCS is a tool-grounded multi - agent framework that reformulates chemical problem - solving into an interpretable, iterative workflow, integrating generative modeling with deterministic chemical logic and achieving SOTA that lets open - weight models match or surpass closed - source ones.
blocks.zh: TMCS是一个基于工具的多剂框架,它重新定义了化学问题——解决成一个可解释的、迭代的工作流程,将基因模型与确定化学逻辑相结合,并实现允许打开的SOTA——重量模型匹配或超过闭源模型。
